informal_statement: For every admissible type-\(\mathrm B\) angle \(\beta\), \(\sin(\beta+\arccos\lambda)\) is nonnegative, without a separate density assumption.
reason: `CMVBallCase.lean:72-80`: Lean has only `BAdmissible lam beta`, without density bounds. The proof uses global nonnegativity of \(\arccos\) to put \(\beta +\arccos (\lambda )\) in \([0,\pi ]\); the author explicitly preserves this wider density domain and non-strict conclusion.
